All landlord-facing strings for the demo chrome live here per the repo rule — components never inline user-facing text.` Repo-wide grep for `demo_banner_message` finds only copy.gleam:382 and the build artifact — zero view references.

title: r1 W19 half-fixed: 'Grace Kelly' still ships in the client fixture; only the PDF was renamed to 'Gráinne Foley', creating a UI↔PDF name mismatch
evidence:
demo_fixtures.gleam:93: `"first_name\":\"Grace\",\"last_name\":\"Kelly\"` in the same blob as `\"has_eviction_history\":true,\"eviction_details\":\"Rent arrears, possession order settled in 2024\",\"has_ccjs\":true` and `\"status\":\"rejected\"` — while pdf_prebake.gleam:212-213 builds the same applicant as `"Gráinne",

recommended_fix: Rename the client fixture first/last name to match the PDF ('Gráinne'/'Foley'), update report_filenames, and regenerate — keep both sides identical.

title: r1 W11 carry-forward: deep-linked demo edit URL still boots with an empty form — demo_entry_effects has no VacancyEdit arm
detail: Briefing fold 'edit deep-link boots with its payload' didn't land: on refresh of /vacancies/v-maples/edit the demo boots (is_demo_route matches 'v-' ids) but never dispatches demo_api.get_for_edit, so the form renders empty fields.
recommended_fix: Add a `routes.VacancyEdit(id) -> [demo_api.get_for_edit(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit)]` arm to demo_entry_effects (and set vacancy_edit_loading: True at entry).

title: r1 W13 carry-forward: 'Reset demo' from a non-dashboard page still strands the page on a permanent skeleton — reset_demo neither navigates home nor refetches route data
evidence: reset_demo returns `Model(..model, ... vacancy_detail: NotAsked, leaderboard: NotAsked, application_detail: NotAsked, comparison_details: NotAsked, archived_vacancies: NotAsked, awaiting_list: NotAsked, notifications: NotAsked, toasts: [],), demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications),` — no modem.push, and the only effect is the notifications fetch. application_detail.gleam:40 renders `NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()`.
detail: Briefing fold 'reset navigates home' didn't land. Resetting while on an applicant-detail/archived/comparison page sets its data to NotAsked with no refetch and no navigation — the animate-pulse skeleton renders forever.
recommended_fix: In reset_demo add `modem.push("/demo", None, None)` to the effect batch (or refetch the current route's data via demo_entry_effects).

title: Structural no-network lint is blind to api calls reached through helper modules — poller.tick_effects fires three real api modules and AppPolledData is absent from the manifest
evidence: lint_demo_network.py scans only `path = "client/src/client.gleam"` and `api_call_on` matches a literal `\b(vacancy_api|application_api|...)\.[a-z_]+` on the line. helpers/poller.gleam:50-93 contains `notification_api.fetch_notifications(on_response: msg.ApiReturnedNotificationsRefresh,)`, `vacancy_api.list_vacancies(msg.ApiReturnedDashboardRefresh)`, `vacancy_api.get_detail(id, msg.ApiReturnedVacancyDetailRefresh)`, `application_api.fetch_leaderboard(id, ...)` — reached from client.gleam's `AppPolledData` arm via `poller.tick_effects(model, tick)`, and `AppPolledData` is NOT in DEMO_INTERCEPTED (only `AppPolledPaymentStatus` is).
detail: Today demo_update intercepts AppPolledData, but the lint that claims structural enforcement stays green if that interception is removed — real polling GETs would fire from demo undetected. Helper-mediated calls escape the manifest contract entirely.
recommended_fix: Scan helpers/poller.gleam too (or ban api-module imports in helpers/), and add AppPolledData to DEMO_INTERCEPTED so the manifest promise ('in sync with demo_update.handle or the lint fails') holds.

title: r1 W20 half-fixed: pdf_prebake still exits 0 after 'FAILED: n of m PDFs failed'
evidence:
main()'s failure branch is only `_ ->
      io.println(
        "FAILED: "
          <> int_to_string(failures)
          <> " of "
          <> int_to_string(list.length(results))
          <> " PDFs failed",
      )` — then main returns; no halt/non-zero exit anywhere (grep for halt/sys.exit finds nothing).
detail: The env-override half of r1 W20 landed (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR, line 506), but a scripted regeneration still cannot detect bake failures — the tool prints FAILED and exits 0.
recommended_fix: On failures > 0, print the message then exit non-zero (e.g. via erlang halt(1) FFI or argv-based exit) so CI/scripts catch failed bakes.

title: Public demo PDFs carry em-dashes and drift from the client store's copy of the same flag string; pdf_prebake sits outside lint_em_dash scope
evidence: pdf_prebake.gleam:361: `flags: "[{\"label\":\"Rent sits at 72% of stated income — borderline\"...` (em-dash) vs demo_store.gleam:247: `"[{\"label\":\"Rent sits at 72% of stated income - borderline\"...` (hyphen). pdf_prebake.gleam contains 7 em-dash characters in string literals; lint_em_dash.py's SERVER_INCLUDE list does not include server/src/demo/ and passes clean ('em-dash lint clean (131 files scanned)').
detail: The two mirrors of the same fixture string differ (em-dash vs hyphen), and the em-dash ban (#607 user ruling: no em-dash in landlord-facing copy) doesn't reach these public marketing PDFs.
recommended_fix: Normalise pdf_prebake strings to the client store's hyphenated copy and add server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam to lint_em_dash.py's scope.

title: report_download_test pins the id mapping but not the 'baked-asset keying' it claims — nothing verifies the 8 PDFs exist on disk
evidence: The test header claims "the analysis-id → application-id mapping and the baked-asset keying must stay aligned, or every demo download 404s", but every_baked_report_has_a_matching_analysis_test only round-trips `demo_store.report_filenames()` against `demo_api.application_id_from_analysis` in memory; neither the test nor any other references server/priv/static/demo/report-a-*.pdf (grep finds no reader). demo_api.gleam:400 builds the URL as `"/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf"` — untested.
detail: The mapping pin can genuinely fail (verified semantics), but a deleted/renamed baked PDF or URL-format change 404s every demo download with no test failing — half the claimed pin is vacuous.
recommended_fix: Add a test that walks server/priv/static/demo/ (simplifile) and asserts one report-<id>.pdf exists per report_filenames entry.
